name: Shaolin Cipher
description: Kung fu cinema meets gritty New York: black and gold, stencil and brush type, concrete grit, red chop-mark stamps (decorative only). A martial-arts film title card for player intros, a vinyl-record stat card and brush-stroke wipes. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
